text: He said, ‘I shall be away in London a good deal. I cannot live here the whole time, even in your holidays.’
speaker: narrator

text: But then, said, ‘No. No, you had really much better be playing cricket in the sun, Edmund, something of that sort. You have been shown everything there is in the Red Room.’
speaker: narrator

text: His father had said, ‘But look at all the others, so much larger and brighter. You had better take the old playroom and have that to yourself.’
speaker: narrator

text: Joseph Hooper sighed. ‘That is not the sort of thing to way, it is not something we need to be concerned with now.’
speaker: narrator

text: Hooper said ‘Why have you come here?’
speaker: narrator

text: He said quietly, ‘Downstairs is something very valuable. Something you’ve never seen.’
speaker: narrator

text: Hooper raised his eyebrows, ‘I should think there would be about a hundred schools in Wales. More than a hundred.’
speaker: narrator

text: Hooper said, ‘you can keep it if you like.’
speaker: narrator

text: Mrs Helena Kingshaw said, ‘Charles is a very sensible little boy. Though – oh, yes, I wonder so often if we are doing the right thing, if he is not still too young...’
speaker: narrator

text: He wrote home, ‘I like it here very much, it is smashing here.’
speaker: narrator
